altText: Two invented wells are measured at the same fictional 2-hour endpoint with the same identifiable target definition: target-only has 30 dead target events out of 100 and targets plus effectors has 40 out of 100. Each target glyph summarizes 10 target events; these are aggregate illustrations rather than individual fates. Matched bars show 30% and 40%, a 10 percentage-point effector-associated excess. Effectors remain outside the target denominator. The subtraction does not identify which individual deaths effectors caused, establish a normalized-lysis value or predict patient response.
